_flir_file_options.note: Use all_components for full LoadShedding board with 120 ROIs. Use test3_subset for limited Test_3 data (5 ROIs only).

sessions.notes: Batch 2: Multi-device (Device 0 has 6 channels + Device 1 has 2 channels = 8 total measurements). Using Load_Shedding_FLIR_AllComponents.csv with actual component designators. Placeholder mappings - components (U2, R5, C3, L1, DL1, C4, R8, DL2) are different from Batch 1 (U3, U1, J1, R13, DL3). User should update with actual measured components later.
